summary.text: Wesley Haffenden is the Democratic candidate for the Indiana House of Representatives, District 83, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Christopher Judy.
A real estate broker and small business owner in Northeast Indiana, he lists lowering costs, raising wages and reducing the influence of money in politics among his priorities.

paragraphs.text: Wesley Haffenden graduated from Garrett High School, earned an associate degree from Ivy Tech Community College in 2017, a bachelor's degree from Indiana University Fort Wayne in 2020, and a graduate degree from Western Governors University in 2023.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a seventh-generation Hoosier raised in a working-class family in Northeast Indiana and the first in his family to earn a bachelor's degree.
He said he has worked in real estate for nearly a decade and served as student body vice president in college and co-created the first Pride march in Fort Wayne.
Haffenden advanced from the Democratic primary for District 83 on May 5, 2026, without a primary opponent.
He said in his survey that he supports raising the minimum wage, expanding workers' rights, and taking on utility, healthcare and housing costs.

He also said he supports term limits, independent redistricting, citizen referendums and stronger campaign finance laws, as well as reproductive rights, LGBTQ+ equality, and legalizing cannabis with expungement for past convictions.
